plan.title: SRC-SET-004 Closed RFQ with Two Bids

steps.note: Open the multi-stage event creation flow.
Provide the required event title so the RFQ can be published.
Configure the event as an RFQ rather than the default auction stage.
Apply an RFQ pricing template before adding line items.
Add the specified product and quantity; the product search targets the requested line item.
Complete the RFQ pricing sheet, including the requested delivery information where available.
Commit the closest supported short bidding window; exact 15-minute scheduling is not expressible.
Invite exactly two QA test vendors for Vendor A and Vendor B bids.
Publish the RFQ so the invited vendors can submit quotes.
Confirm the event reached a published project page.
Have the first invited QA vendor submit the 100 quote.
Verify the first vendor's quote was accepted by the vendor portal.
Have the second invited QA vendor submit the 90 quote.
Verify the second vendor's quote was accepted by the vendor portal.
Wait for the RFQ bidding window to expire naturally rather than force-ending it.
Assert that the RFQ now shows the expected Closed status.
